name: muse-video-prompts
note: 种子条目由「AI 视频工作流空间」原创整理，作者统一标注为“空间整理”，来源为“站内原创”，不编造作者与原帖链接。外部转载条目须填真实作者与原帖链接。

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 清晨阳光从窗户斜照进来，一位年轻女性坐在窗边自拍，镜头缓慢前推贴近她的笑脸，暖金色光线，松弛治愈的氛围，16:9
prompts.en: Morning sunlight slants through a window as a young woman takes a selfie by the window, camera slowly dollies in toward her smiling face, warm golden light, relaxed healing mood, 16:9
prompts.title: 晨光窗边自拍

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 雨夜街头霓虹灯下，年轻人举着手机自拍，雨滴落在镜头前形成光斑，镜头固定，城市灯光虚化成彩色光晕，电影感
prompts.en: On a rainy night street under neon lights, a young person holds up a phone for a selfie, raindrops blur into bokeh in front of the lens, locked-off shot, city lights melt into colorful halos, cinematic
prompts.title: 雨夜霓虹自拍

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 海边日落时分，女孩回头对镜头笑，海风吹起长发，镜头缓慢环绕她半圈，金色海面与晚霞同框，9:16 竖屏
prompts.en: At sunset by the sea, a girl turns back and smiles at the camera, sea breeze lifts her long hair, camera slowly orbits halfway around her, golden sea and sunset clouds in frame, 9:16 vertical
prompts.title: 海边回眸自拍

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 女孩站在全身镜前自拍，镜头固定，只拍镜中倒影，她换了三套衣服，每换一套灯光颜色跟着变，轻快节奏
prompts.en: A girl takes a selfie in front of a full-length mirror, locked-off shot on the mirror reflection only, she changes three outfits and the light color shifts with each one, upbeat rhythm
prompts.title: 镜子前的换装自拍

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 山顶大风中，登山者举起手机自拍，云海在身后翻滚，镜头轻微手持晃动，真实纪录片质感，冷峻蓝灰色调
prompts.en: On a windy mountain peak, a hiker raises a phone for a selfie, a sea of clouds rolls behind, subtle handheld shake, raw documentary feel, cold blue-grey tones
prompts.title: 山顶风中自拍

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 清晨厨房，第一人称视角煮咖啡、煎蛋、烤面包，蒸汽升起，镜头跟随手部动作平滑移动，暖光、生活气息浓
prompts.en: Early morning kitchen, first-person view brewing coffee, frying an egg, toasting bread, steam rising, camera glides smoothly following the hands, warm light, cozy everyday life
prompts.title: 清晨厨房 Vlog

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 早高峰地铁站，人群中主角边走边拍，镜头轻微晃动，记录通勤的真实节奏，城市冷色调，配轻快脚步声
prompts.en: Morning rush at a metro station, the vlogger walks and films through the crowd, slight handheld shake, the real rhythm of commuting, cool urban tones, light footsteps
prompts.title: 通勤路上 Vlog

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 周末农夫市集，镜头横移扫过摊位上的水果、花束和手作，阳光透过遮阳棚洒下光斑，色彩鲜亮、热闹松弛
prompts.en: Weekend farmers market, camera pans laterally across stalls of fruit, bouquets and crafts, sunlight dapples through the canopy, vivid colors, lively and relaxed
prompts.title: 周末市集 Vlog

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 深夜办公室只剩一盏台灯，主角收拾电脑包起身离开，镜头从身后跟随，穿过空荡走廊，寂静中只有脚步声
prompts.en: Late night office with only one desk lamp left, the vlogger packs up and leaves, camera tracks from behind through the empty corridor, silence except footsteps
prompts.title: 深夜加班 Vlog

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 阳台上给多肉浇水、松土，镜头近景拍水珠落在叶片上，阳光明媚，慢节奏治愈，配鸟鸣环境音
prompts.en: Watering and loosening soil for succulents on a balcony, close-up of droplets on leaves, bright sunshine, slow healing pace, birdsong ambience
prompts.title: 阳台种花 Vlog

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 主角推开一扇木门，镜头跟随穿过门洞，门后场景从卧室瞬间变成海边，门框作为天然遮罩完成转场
prompts.en: The subject pushes open a wooden door, camera follows through the doorway, the scene beyond instantly changes from bedroom to seaside, the door frame masking the transition
prompts.title: 推门转场

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 主角抬手蒙住镜头，画面变黑，松开手时场景已从白天切到夜晚的同一条街，灯光全亮
prompts.en: The subject covers the lens with a hand, the frame goes black, and when the hand lifts the same street has changed from day to night, all lights on
prompts.title: 蒙眼转场

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 主角原地转身，镜头快速跟随旋转 360 度，转完一圈场景从室内客厅变成山顶草原，动作不停、衔接顺滑
prompts.en: The subject spins in place, camera whips around 360 degrees with the turn, and after one full rotation the living room has become a mountaintop meadow, motion unbroken
prompts.title: 旋转跳切

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 镜头贴近湖面拍倒影，倒影里是城市高楼，镜头缓缓抬起越过水面，真实场景变成雪山湖泊
prompts.en: Camera skims the lake surface filming the reflection of city towers, then slowly rises above the water to reveal a snowy mountain lake
prompts.title: 水面倒影转场

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 一本书在桌上翻页，镜头贴近书页，翻过去的那一页变成真实场景，书页纹理过渡成街道石板路
prompts.en: A book flips its pages on a desk, camera close on the paper, the turning page dissolves into a real scene, page texture becoming cobblestones
prompts.title: 翻书页转场

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 江南雨巷，青衣女子撑油纸伞缓步走来，青石板倒映着灯笼光，镜头缓慢前推，烟雨朦胧、水墨色调
prompts.en: A rainy Jiangnan alley, a woman in teal robes walks slowly under an oil-paper umbrella, bluestone slabs mirror lantern light, slow dolly-in, misty ink-wash tones
prompts.title: 雨巷油纸伞

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 竹林深处，白衣琴师抚琴，竹叶随风飘落，镜头环绕琴师缓慢移动，阳光透过竹叶洒下斑驳光影，空灵寂静
prompts.en: Deep in a bamboo grove, a musician in white plays the guqin, leaves drift down, camera orbits slowly, sunlight speckles through the bamboo, ethereal and still
prompts.title: 竹林抚琴

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 长安上元灯会，红灯笼连成一片，汉服人群穿梭，镜头从高处缓缓下降俯冲进人群，热闹辉煌、金红主调
prompts.en: Lantern Festival in Chang'an, red lanterns stretch endlessly, crowds in hanfu drift through, camera dives slowly from above into the crowd, festive golden-red splendor
prompts.title: 长安灯会

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 月夜庭院，剑客白衣舞剑，剑光划出银色弧线，落叶被剑气卷起，镜头固定中景，只拍剑与身影
prompts.en: Moonlit courtyard, a swordsman in white dances with his blade, silver arcs cut the air, fallen leaves swirl up, locked-off medium shot on blade and silhouette
prompts.title: 剑客月下舞剑

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 水墨山水画卷缓缓展开，画中云雾流动、渔舟荡漾，镜头推进画卷深处，画与实景交融，黑白灰主调
prompts.en: An ink-wash landscape scroll slowly unrolls, clouds drift and a fishing boat rocks within the painting, camera pushes deep into the scroll where painting and reality merge, black-white-grey palette
prompts.title: 水墨山水入画

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 特写雨滴敲打窗玻璃，雨珠滑落轨迹清晰，机位固定，画面只有雨与窗，雨声是唯一的声音
prompts.en: Extreme close-up of raindrops tapping a windowpane, droplets sliding in clear trails, locked-off shot, only rain and glass in frame, rain the only sound
prompts.title: 雨声敲窗

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 炭火上小壶煮水，水汽袅袅，茶叶投入发出轻响，镜头近景固定，暖光、慢节奏，突出水声与火声
prompts.en: A small kettle boils over charcoal, steam curls up, tea leaves drop with a soft hiss, locked-off close-up, warm light, slow pace, water and fire sounds
prompts.title: 炭火烤茶

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 毛笔缓缓蘸入墨汁，墨色晕开，笔尖在宣纸上落下第一笔，镜头特写固定，寂静中只有笔触沙沙声
prompts.en: A brush slowly dips into ink, black blooms outward, the tip lands its first stroke on rice paper, locked-off extreme close-up, only the soft scratch of the brush
prompts.title: 毛笔蘸墨

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 细沙从指缝缓缓流下，落在木盘里堆成小丘，镜头特写，沙粒声清晰，画面极简、节奏催眠
prompts.en: Fine sand trickles slowly through fingers onto a wooden tray, piling into a small dune, extreme close-up, crisp grain sounds, minimal frame, hypnotic rhythm
prompts.title: 沙子流淌

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 旧书在暖光下缓慢翻页，纸张泛黄、边缘卷曲，镜头贴近书页，翻页声与纸张摩擦声交替，怀旧安静
prompts.en: An old book turns its pages slowly under warm light, yellowed paper with curled edges, camera close on the pages, page turns and paper rustle alternate, nostalgic and quiet
prompts.title: 旧书翻页

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 火车站台，情侣相拥告别，列车进站气流吹起衣角，镜头缓慢后拉，站台渐渐空旷，冷暖色调对比强烈
prompts.en: On a train platform, lovers embrace goodbye, the arriving train stirs their coats, camera dollies out slowly as the platform empties, strong warm-cold contrast
prompts.title: 车站告别

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 雨夜小巷，侦探举伞追赶黑影，路灯一明一暗，镜头手持跟随，呼吸感强，青黑色调、悬疑拉满
prompts.en: Rainy night alley, a detective chases a shadow under an umbrella, streetlights flicker, handheld tracking with breathing motion, teal-black grade, thick suspense
prompts.title: 雨夜追凶

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 阁楼尘埃中，女孩打开一封旧信，阳光从气窗斜射进来照亮信纸，镜头缓推至信纸特写，时光感扑面
prompts.en: In a dusty attic, a girl opens an old letter, sunlight slants through the skylight onto the paper, camera pushes in to an extreme close-up of the letter, time itself in the frame
prompts.title: 阁楼旧信

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 天台黄昏，两个少年坐在边缘晃着腿，城市灯火在脚下亮起，镜头环绕两人半圈，青春与告别的味道
prompts.en: Rooftop at dusk, two teenagers sit on the edge swinging their legs, city lights flicker on below, camera orbits halfway around them, youth and farewell in the air
prompts.title: 天台约定

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 末班公交上只剩一位老人，车窗外霓虹流过，镜头固定拍老人侧脸，车厢安静，孤独与温暖并存
prompts.en: Only an old man remains on the last bus, neon streams past the windows, locked-off shot on his profile, quiet carriage, loneliness and warmth together
prompts.title: 最后一班车

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 手表表盘特写，一滴水缓缓滑过蓝宝石镜面，折射出光芒，镜头极慢前推，黑底、高级质感
prompts.en: Extreme close-up of a watch dial, a water droplet glides across the sapphire crystal catching light, ultra-slow push-in, black background, premium feel
prompts.title: 手表水滴特写

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 香水瓶立在晨光窗台，喷出的雾气在光柱中散开，镜头环绕瓶身半圈，通透、清新、高级
prompts.en: A perfume bottle stands on a sunlit windowsill, mist blooms in the light beam, camera orbits halfway around the bottle, clear, fresh, luxurious
prompts.title: 香水晨光

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 球鞋从高处落下砸在地面弹起，慢动作拍鞋底气垫压缩回弹，镜头低机位固定，力量感十足
prompts.en: A sneaker drops and bounces off the ground, slow motion on the air cushion compressing and rebounding, low locked-off camera, pure power
prompts.title: 球鞋弹跳

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 咖啡师拉花，奶泡在咖啡表面绽开成叶形，镜头俯视固定，蒸汽升起，暖色、治愈、食欲感
prompts.en: A barista pours latte art, milk foam blooms into a leaf on the coffee, top-down locked-off shot, steam rising, warm, healing, appetizing
prompts.title: 咖啡拉花

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 年轻人戴耳机穿过城市，世界声音渐渐消失只剩音乐，镜头跟随侧面横移，耳机特写一闪而过
prompts.en: A young person crosses the city wearing earphones, the world's noise fades until only music remains, lateral tracking shot, a flash close-up of the earphones
prompts.title: 耳机城市漫游

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 雪山之巅日出，金光漫过山脊，云海翻腾，镜头缓慢拉远露出整片山脉，壮阔史诗感
prompts.en: Sunrise over snowy peaks, gold spills across the ridges, clouds churn below, camera pulls back slowly to reveal the whole range, epic grandeur
prompts.title: 雪山日出

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 沙漠夜空银河横贯，帐篷灯光暖黄，镜头固定延时感，星星缓缓移动，寂静辽阔
prompts.en: Milky Way arcs over desert night, tent light glows warm yellow, locked-off timelapse feel, stars drifting slowly, silent vastness
prompts.title: 沙漠星空

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 无人机俯瞰海岛，碧绿海水环绕白沙滩，渔船划出白色尾迹，镜头缓慢盘旋下降，度假感拉满
prompts.en: Drone view of an island, turquoise water rings white sand, a fishing boat trails white wake, camera spirals down slowly, pure holiday
prompts.title: 海岛航拍

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 秋日枫林小径，红叶飘落铺满石板路，行人缓步走过，镜头跟随身后，暖红与金黄交织
prompts.en: Autumn maple trail, red leaves drift onto the stone path, a walker strolls through, camera tracks from behind, warm reds and golds intertwined
prompts.title: 秋日枫林

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 北极夜空极光舞动，绿色光带缓缓流动，雪地反射微光，镜头固定仰拍，神秘震撼
prompts.en: Aurora dances across the arctic night, green ribbons flowing slowly, snow catching faint light, locked-off upward shot, mysterious and overwhelming
prompts.title: 极光之夜

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 阳光下猫咪蜷在窗台午睡，肚皮一起一伏，镜头缓慢前推至胡须特写，温暖治愈
prompts.en: A cat naps curled on a sunny windowsill, belly rising and falling, camera pushes in slowly to a whisker close-up, warm and healing
prompts.title: 猫咪午睡

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 草地上狗狗腾空跃起接住飞盘，慢动作拍它在空中的姿态，镜头跟随横移，阳光、活力、快乐
prompts.en: A dog leaps into the air to catch a frisbee on the grass, slow motion on its airborne pose, lateral tracking, sunshine, energy, joy
prompts.title: 狗狗接飞盘

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 熊猫抱着竹子慢悠悠啃食，镜头固定中景，竹叶轻晃，憨态可掬、治愈满分
prompts.en: A panda cradles bamboo and munches unhurriedly, locked-off medium shot, leaves swaying gently, irresistibly cute and healing
prompts.title: 熊猫吃竹子

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 海豚跃出海面划出弧线，水花四溅，镜头跟随横移，阳光下水珠晶莹，自由感扑面
prompts.en: A dolphin arcs out of the sea, spray flying, lateral tracking shot, sunlit droplets sparkling, pure freedom
prompts.title: 海豚跃浪

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 一排小鸭子摇摇摆摆跟在鸭妈妈身后过小桥，镜头低机位跟随，童趣十足
prompts.en: A line of ducklings waddles after their mother across a small bridge, low tracking camera, pure childlike charm
prompts.title: 小鸭子排队

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 拉面出锅，热气腾腾，筷子挑起面条，汤汁滴落，镜头特写固定，食欲感拉满
prompts.en: Fresh ramen leaves the pot, steam rising, chopsticks lift the noodles, broth dripping, locked-off close-up, pure appetite
prompts.title: 拉面出锅

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 夜市烤串摊，炭火通红，肉串滋滋作响、油花四溅，镜头近景横移扫过整排烤串，烟火气十足
prompts.en: Night market barbecue stall, charcoal glowing red, skewers sizzling and spattering oil, close lateral pan across the row, thick smoky street life
prompts.title: 街头烤串

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 刀缓缓切开草莓蛋糕，奶油与草莓层层显露，镜头特写，慢动作，甜蜜治愈
prompts.en: A knife slowly cuts a strawberry cake, cream and berry layers revealed, extreme close-up in slow motion, sweet and healing
prompts.title: 切开蛋糕

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 一家人围坐包饺子，手起馅落、饺子排成行，镜头俯视固定，蒸汽与笑声，年味扑面
prompts.en: A family gathers to fold dumplings, hands moving, dumplings lining up in rows, top-down locked-off shot, steam and laughter, New Year in the air
prompts.title: 包饺子

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 夏日冰镇西瓜一切两半，红瓤黑籽、水珠晶莹，镜头特写，凉爽感扑面而来
prompts.en: A chilled summer watermelon splits in half, red flesh, black seeds, glistening droplets, extreme close-up, instant coolness
prompts.title: 冰镇西瓜

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 赛博朋克都市雨夜，霓虹招牌倒映在积水路面，飞行器掠过楼顶，镜头缓慢前推，青紫主调
prompts.en: Cyberpunk city on a rainy night, neon signs mirrored in puddles, aircraft skimming rooftops, slow push-in, teal-purple grade
prompts.title: 霓虹都市雨夜

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 空间站舷窗外地球缓缓转动，宇航员漂浮着伸手触碰窗面，镜头固定，寂静辽阔、敬畏感
prompts.en: Earth turns slowly beyond a space station window, an astronaut floats and reaches for the glass, locked-off shot, silent vastness and awe
prompts.title: 空间站舷窗

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 实验室里机器人缓缓睁开眼睛，瞳孔亮起蓝光，机械手指轻微抽动，镜头特写，紧张又好奇
prompts.en: In a lab, a robot slowly opens its eyes, pupils glowing blue, mechanical fingers twitching, extreme close-up, tense and curious
prompts.title: 机器人初醒

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 主角穿过发光的时光隧道，光线拉成细线向后飞逝，镜头跟随身后，速度感与眩晕感并存
prompts.en: The hero rushes through a glowing time tunnel, light streaking past, camera tracking from behind, speed and vertigo together
prompts.title: 时光隧道

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 火星地表日出，红色荒漠尽头太阳升起，探测车轮廓剪影，镜头缓慢拉远，孤独与希望
prompts.en: Sunrise on the Martian surface, the sun rising over red desert, a rover in silhouette, slow pull-back, loneliness and hope
prompts.title: 火星日出

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 冲浪者踏浪而行，浪花在身后卷起，镜头跟随侧面横移，阳光、海水、速度感
prompts.en: A surfer rides the wave, spray curling behind, lateral tracking shot, sun, sea, speed
prompts.title: 冲浪逐浪

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 滑板少年跃上栏杆滑行落地，慢动作拍腾空瞬间，镜头低机位跟随，街头自由感
prompts.en: A skater grinds a rail and lands, slow motion on the airborne moment, low tracking camera, street freedom
prompts.title: 街头滑板

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 清晨跑者穿过城市街道，脚步轻快，镜头在身后跟随，晨光洒在路面，活力满满
prompts.en: A morning runner crosses city streets, light footsteps, camera tracking from behind, dawn light on the road, full of energy
prompts.title: 晨跑城市

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 攀岩者登顶瞬间张开双臂，山风吹动衣角，镜头从下方仰拍缓缓拉远，征服感
prompts.en: A climber throws arms wide at the summit, mountain wind tugging clothes, low-angle camera pulling back slowly, triumph
prompts.title: 攀岩登顶

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 篮球压哨绝杀，球在空中划出弧线落入篮筐，全场欢呼，镜头跟随球的轨迹，热血沸腾
prompts.en: A buzzer-beating basketball arcs through the air and drops through the hoop, the crowd erupts, camera follows the ball's flight, pure adrenaline
prompts.title: 球场绝杀

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 阳台上老人晒着夕阳打盹，猫咪蜷在脚边，镜头固定远景，时间仿佛静止，温暖安宁
prompts.en: An old man dozes in sunset light on a balcony, a cat curled at his feet, locked-off wide shot, time standing still, warm and peaceful
prompts.title: 阳台夕阳

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 雨后天边出现彩虹，孩子指着天空欢呼，镜头缓慢拉远露出整条彩虹与田野，清新治愈
prompts.en: A rainbow appears after rain, a child points at the sky cheering, camera pulls back slowly to reveal the full arc over fields, fresh and healing
prompts.title: 雨后彩虹

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 烛光下手写一封信，笔尖沙沙作响，墨迹未干，镜头特写固定，慢节奏、温暖怀旧
prompts.en: Writing a letter by candlelight, the pen scratching softly, ink still wet, locked-off close-up, slow, warm, nostalgic
prompts.title: 手写信

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 田野晚风吹动麦浪，金黄波纹层层推进，镜头缓慢横移，配虫鸣，治愈催眠
prompts.en: Evening wind ripples golden wheat, waves rolling on, slow lateral pan, crickets singing, healing and hypnotic
prompts.title: 田野晚风

prompts.author: 空间整理
prompts.cn: 寒夜一杯热茶，双手捧杯、热气氤氲，窗外飘雪，镜头近景固定，温暖治愈
prompts.en: A cup of hot tea on a cold night, hands wrapped around it, steam curling, snow falling outside, locked-off close-up, warm and healing
prompts.title: 一杯热茶
